screener_description: Sanghvi Movers provides medium to heavy duty cranes on rental basis to various private and public sector undertakings. SML’s crane fleet consists of medium to large size hydraulic truck mounted telescopic and lattice boom cranes and crawler lattice boom cranes having a lifting capacity ranging from 20 MT to 1000  MT.
